headline: Weathered Expanse Leads Renewed Front-Line Action
war_summary: The latest returns show the campaign’s chief movement concentrated in Weathered Expanse, Mooring County, and Marban Hollow. Weathered Expanse has shifted since the previous edition from three Warden, two Colonial, and four neutral bases to five Warden, one Colonial, and three neutral; it logged 71 strategic-base events in 24 hours, including three in the latest two-hour window, while casualties and enlistments accelerate on both sides. Mooring County, formerly reported wholly under Warden control, now stands at ten Warden and two Colonial bases, with 49 daily events and five in the latest two hours. Marban Hollow has likewise altered, moving from six Colonial and one neutral base to five Colonial and two neutral, with five events in the latest two hours and 18 across the day. Stlican Shelf remains at one Warden and eight Colonial bases after 18 daily events, though its latest recorded action is several hours old. Linn’s Mercy shows two recent ownership events amid sharply rising casualties. Callahan’s Passage remains Warden-held with eight daily events, but no fresh movement in the latest six hours.
